datasetsRegistry.name: Audited 100-Offer General Holdout Benchmark
datasetsRegistry.scopeTaxonomy: 6 classes (ONLINE, SINGLE_BRANCH, MULTIPLE_BRANCHES, SELECTED_OUTLETS, NATIONWIDE, UNRESOLVED)
datasetsRegistry.legacyExactPinsPrecision: 100.00% (11/11 verified, single-branch offers only; multi-branch suppressed by legacy policy)

previousReportCombinedCount.explanation: Previous report combined 11 legacy pins (Dataset 1) + 23 baseline branch pins (Dataset 2) = 34 total pins. This was a cross-dataset composite.

currentDataset2StandaloneCount.explanation: 53 verified exact pins placed on Dataset 2 alone (up from 23 in baseline run, representing +30 newly recovered verified pins).

additionalRecoveryMetric.formula: 53 (updated Dataset 2 pins) - 23 (baseline Dataset 2 pins) = +30 newly verified branch pins

combinedCrossDatasetTotal.formula: 11 (Dataset 1 legacy pins) + 53 (Dataset 2 pins) = 64 total verified pins across all evaluated benchmark offers
combinedCrossDatasetTotal.warning: Never report 64 pins against a single dataset denominator; denominators must strictly reference their specific benchmark population.
